top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation's play structures did not have the correct depth of loose fill. The play structures need six inches of loose fill.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Criteria for Extreme Weather (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18)(F))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policies did not include the criteria used to determine when extreme weather conditions pose a significant health risk that prohibits or limits outdoor play

top_violation_types.title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records (26 TAC §746.801(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Training records were not available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The grassy area on one of the operations playgrounds was found to have a deep step down with the sprinkler system being exposed.

top_violation_types.title: Screen Time Activities - May Supplement Activities Not Replace (26 TAC §746.2207(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: At the time of inspection, school age children are using their cells phones to watch videos and play games.

top_violation_types.title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2021 data from February 23, 2022, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2021 by February 22, 2022, as required.

top_violation_types.title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not conduct a fire drill for the month of August.
